newsitem.title: USA: Anergen vaccine blocks diabetes in study.
newsitem.headline: Anergen vaccine blocks diabetes in study.

text.p: Anergen Inc said results from a preclinical study of its cyclic peptide vaccine DiavaX(TM) suggest an ability to delay and suppress the development of Type I diabetes.
In the study, non-obese diabetic (NOD) mice, the murine model for human Type I diabetes, were treated with DiavaX(TM), a proprietary Anergen compound.
DiavaX is composed of specific synthetic peptides that stimulate production of antibodies which block T cell activation, preventing the onset of diabetes.
